title: Federation — join the fediverse
notes: Convoro now speaks ActivityPub. Enable Federation under Admin → Settings and your community becomes a followable fediverse account — people on Mastodon, Lemmy and beyond can follow @your-community and see every new discussion in their feed. Discoverable via WebFinger; follows auto-accepted; new topics delivered to followers, signed.

changelog.text: Federation (ActivityPub): your community is a followable fediverse actor — WebFinger discovery, auto-accepted follows, and signed delivery of new topics to followers. Enable it under Admin → Settings.
